## Filter Visuals

This page demonstrates **every filter and input control** type available in Report-SQL.

| Control | Type | Binds to |
|---------|------|----------|
| Category Filter | `SLICER` | `@category` |
| Region Filter | `MULTISELECT` | `@region` |
| Start Date | `DATEPICKER` | `@startDate` |
| End Date | `DATEPICKER` | `@endDate` |
| Min Quantity | `SLIDER` | `@minQty` |
| Keyword | `SEARCH` | `@search` |
| Include Returns | `CHECKBOX` | `@includeReturns` |
| Analyst Note | `TEXTBOX` | `@analystNote` |
| Min Revenue | `NUMBERBOX` | `@minRevenue` |

Changes to any control above propagate instantly to all dependent visuals (without a full page reload).

> **Tip:** Filter/input visuals hide the maximize button by default so control hit targets stay clear.
> Use `STYLE (ALLOW_MAXIMIZE = ON)` only when a control really benefits from full-screen inspection.

### Buttons
`CREATE BUTTON` defines interactive command buttons with `ACTIONS`.

| Name | Action | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| BtnRefresh | `REFRESH_REPORT` | Force rebuild of all visual snapshots |
| BtnRefreshSelected | `REFRESH_VISUALS` | Re-query selected visuals only |
| BtnClearFilters | `CLEAR_FILTERS` | Reset active selections and parameters |
| BtnApplyParams | `APPLY_PARAMETERS` | Apply staged run-to-data controls |
| BtnBack | `BACK` | Navigate to previous browser page |
| BtnExport | `EXPORT_CSV` | Export the transaction table |

Buttons can be placed in page or container `MAP` slots exactly like visuals.

## Showcase Additions

This page groups newer report capabilities that are easy to miss in normal dashboards:

| Feature | Demonstrated by |
|---------|-----------------|
| Rich table renderers | IMAGE badges, safe hyperlinks, data bars, color scales, and sparklines |
| Run-to-data workflow | Deferred table starts hidden until parameters are applied |
| Targeted refresh | `REFRESH_VISUALS` updates selected visuals without a full rebuild |
| Viewer state actions | `CLEAR_FILTERS`, `BACK`, and `EXPORT_CSV` |
| Maximize policy | Controls hide maximize by default; data-heavy visuals can opt in with `ALLOW_MAXIMIZE = ON` |

The same source data drives cards, charts, filters, rich tables, and action buttons so the report feels like one cohesive application rather than a set of isolated chart samples.

## Showcase Additions

This page groups newer report capabilities that are easy to miss in normal dashboards:

| Feature | Demonstrated by |
|---------|-----------------|
| Rich table renderers | IMAGE badges, safe hyperlinks, data bars, color scales, and sparklines |
| Run-to-data workflow | Deferred table starts hidden until parameters are applied |
| Targeted refresh | `REFRESH_VISUALS` updates selected visuals without a full rebuild |
| Viewer state actions | `CLEAR_FILTERS`, `BACK`, and `EXPORT_CSV` |
| Maximize policy | Controls hide maximize by default; data-heavy visuals can opt in with `ALLOW_MAXIMIZE = ON` |

The same source data drives cards, charts, filters, rich tables, and action buttons so the report feels like one cohesive application rather than a set of isolated chart samples.
